steps.text: The claim rests on one empirical premise: that absorbed dietary cholesterol raises serum LDL. Controlled feeding trials and their meta-analyses show a modest, dose-dependent rise, roughly 0.05 mmol/L per 100 mg/day, with wide individual variation. That is enough for supported, not verified: the effect size is small, the trials are short, and a minority of hyper-responders complicate "most adults". I will record the mechanism premise as a subclaim it requires.
create_subclaim: “Absorbed dietary cholesterol raises serum LDL in feeding trials”
